# nd_change_control (Data Source)

Datasource of the change control system settings for Nexus Dashboard

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nd_change_control" "test_resource_change_control_1" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `admin_status` (Boolean) The admin status of the change control.
- `allow_self_approval` (Boolean) The self approval status of the change control for an orchestration action to approve that ticket.
- `bypass_telemetry_change_control` (Boolean) Bypasses change control for telemetry operations in Nexus Dashboard managed fabrics.
- `nd_managed_fabrics` (Boolean) The Nexus Dashboard managed fabrics status of the change control.
- `number_of_approvers` (Number) The number of approvals required for orchestration templates.
- `orchestration` (Boolean) The orchestration status of the change control for ACI fabrics.
- `ticket_name_prefix` (String) The prefix of the ticket name for the change control.
